# PowerOfTwo_Synaptic_Learning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A synaptic weight update scheme restricting changes to powers of two so multiplication can be implemented via bit shifts. Lowers silicon area and energy for on-chip learning in resource-constrained iNEST nodes.
